gh.notFound: Orchester reads CI with gh. Install it from cli.github.com, sign in with this command, then check again.
gh.notSignedIn: Orchester reads the pull request's checks with gh. Sign in to gh in a terminal with this command, then check again. The pull request itself is fine.
gh.readFailed: GitHub didn't give the checks. Orchester tries again in 30 seconds; Check again tries now.
gh.unreachable: Couldn't reach GitHub. Orchester tries again in 30 seconds; Check again tries now.
gh.rateLimited: GitHub limits requests for now. Orchester tries again once the limit resets; Check again tries now.
gh.unavailable: gh can't act as the account this project expects. Check the GitHub connection, then check again.
